# Primate Intelligence

> Real-time video intelligence for the physical world. Point Primate Vision at any camera and ask questions in plain language — live answers, structured data, and alerts with no training or labeling.

NOTE: NON-CANONICAL STUB (PRI-502). The canonical /llms.txt served in production today
lives on the existing site (primateintelligence.ai/llms.txt) and is pinned byte-identical
for the OpenAI submission. This file must be replaced with the canonical content before
any cutover — see PRI-501 URL map (IMMOVABLE URLs).
